[Intro]
Bass - [ch]E[/ch] [ch]B[/ch]  [ch]E[/ch] [ch]B[/ch]  [ch]E[/ch] [ch]B[/ch]  [ch]E[/ch] [ch]B[/ch]

[Verse]
[tab][ch]Em[/ch]                                                        [ch]G[/ch]
Basically we are all alone in the centre of a pickaxe mine.[/tab]
[tab][ch]Em[/ch]
Black lung stings as the pickaxe swings.[/tab]
[tab][ch]Em[/ch]                               [ch]G[/ch]
As the void of the mine closes in,[/tab]
[tab][ch]Em[/ch]
The Devil came and the angels sang.[/tab]
[tab][ch]Em[/ch]                      [ch]G[/ch]
A Song of the Holy Ghost.[/tab]
[tab][ch]Em[/ch]
Tempted the soul from the pennies to the gold,[/tab]
[tab][ch]Em[/ch]                                [ch]G[/ch]
Like the dust I spit from my mouth.[/tab]

[Chorus]
[tab][ch]Em[/ch]                                             [ch]G[/ch]

[tab][ch]Em[/ch]                                             [ch]G[/ch]

[Verse]
[tab][ch]Em[/ch]
Remember the night with the barroom fight[/tab]
[tab][ch]Em[/ch]                                 [ch]G[/ch]
Where I killed all my best friends.[/tab]
[tab][ch]Em[/ch]
We gambled it away with the whiskey open keg,[/tab]
[tab][ch]Em[/ch]                       [ch]G[/ch]
And we never saw it again.[/tab]
[tab][ch]Em[/ch]
Well I had a wife that I met back in high school;[/tab]
[tab][ch]Em[/ch]                    [ch]G[/ch]
Her name was Lyla-Jean.[/tab]
[tab][ch]Em[/ch]
We saved away to escape some place[/tab]
[tab][ch]Em[/ch]                          [ch]G[/ch]
On a local miner's minor pay.[/tab]

[Chorus]
[tab][ch]Em[/ch]                                             [ch]G[/ch]
Wooa Wooa oooo oo oo oooooooo oo oo oooooooo oo[/tab]
[tab][ch]Em[/ch]                                             [ch]G[/ch]
Wooa Wooa oooo oo oo oooooooo oo oo oooooooo oo[/tab]

[Banjo Break]

[Verse]
[tab][ch]Em[/ch]
We saved so long, the fall came and gone[/tab]
[tab][ch]Em[/ch]               [ch]G[/ch]
At Least 27 times.[/tab]
[tab][ch]Em[/ch]
It fell through the floorboards into deep dark darkness,[/tab]
[tab][ch]Em[/ch]                       [ch]G[/ch]
And we never saw it again.[/tab]
[tab][ch]Em[/ch]
So West Virginia's home and that's where we're staying[/tab]
[tab][ch]Em[/ch]                            [ch]G[/ch]
To the blade of the bible hymn.[/tab]
[tab][ch]Em[/ch]
Jesus says we're wicked so we just keep on pickin'[/tab]
